objective: Improve early native-file localization through evidence-driven adaptive complete-method navigation, rather than reorder the same short excerpts.
population: All16 current exposed source cases for initial development, no case removed for missing runtime or oversized method. Source-wide2821-file universe, not the old reach-limited candidate pool. Independent disjoint confirmation remains separate and unopened.
primary_metric: paired native-file Hit@1; MRR@8 secondary. This is a prospectively new top-one discrimination task, not a repair of the failed old three-Hit@3 gate.
candidate_development_gate: All32 episodes and native mappings accounted, valid completion for both arms; at least3 net Hit@1 gains and mean MRR uplift at least0.10 over contemporaneous strong equal-access adaptive baseline, with generation-token ratio at most1.10. Gate must be frozen before responses/labels, not tuned after results. This development gate cannot alone admit superiority.
treatment: The qualified native-method-episode-r1 adapter reuses actual native episode/recycler/receipt/final-selection machinery. Index arm adds existing confirmed source-evidence index and post-recycle observed task state; this is not a new semantic hypothesis evaluator. Shared native pending exchange retention prevents consumption-before-recycle errors in BOTH arms. Exact8K provider transport and live quality/cost enforcement remain prerequisites.
baseline: Strong autonomous covered-method/source exploration followed by a separate final location choice, inspired by AutoFL. Same model, tools, starting failure input, runtime availability, all-source universe and budgets as treatment. Not called an official AutoFL replication: command-phase coverage, canonical-ID tools, file-level metric and any omitted documentation/test-code differences must be stated.

budget_candidate.rule: Same bounds for both arms; exact same-account tokenizer check before every request and cumulative usage accounting. Whole-source/tool replies exceeding the admitted prompt budget are explicit evidence-capacity outcomes, never silently truncated or dropped from cases. Failed/uncertain provider dispatch stops without replay.

evidence_and_output: Only source/runtime observations and closed tool requests/public location IDs. No hidden reasoning, credentials, environment dumps, fixed source or gold enters readers. Validate and seal every prediction and cost before evaluator-only native-label scoring.
history: Old r1b remains failed with15/16 Hit@3 in both arms and slightly lower linkedMRR. Perfect Hit@3 cannot clear its unchanged three-hit gain gate. This successor must test a distinct mechanism against a new strong contemporaneous baseline, not weaken that old control or relabel exposed results as confirmation.
all_in_cost: Retain cold runtime acquisition, original failures, source/method indexing, view construction, native audits, tokenizer calls, tool access and every generation. Do not infer overall speed or efficiency from generation tokens alone.
claim_ceiling: Prospective comparison candidate only; no quality result or superiority claim
open_questions: Which existing native ARE episode implementation supplies the required treatment state transitions with minimal adaptation?
Can exact initial prompts/tool transitions satisfy8K and equal cumulative budgets for all16 without an asymmetric context policy?
Does the strong baseline leave enough paired top-one headroom; if not, preserve that result and use a prospectively justified broader population rather than relax gates?
Which genuinely disjoint trustworthy native population will confirm a development gain and support claim scope?
